active_work_item.title: Deterministic trust evaluation harness
active_work_item.depends_on: CP6-01 independently QA-passed and merged via PR #13 at 387b94a17270d3b660534f80deaa846bb818ca3f
active_work_item.reason: Independent QA failed PR #18 at exact head db8a21e81399d765de2232c23607ce57afb01acf despite green exact-head CI run 34661413007. The deterministic evaluator still does not validate ordinary inference grounding and does not verify that a not_stated finding is actually absent from canonical data. Reproducible counterexamples from current evaluator control flow: a canonical stated 1-year warranty paired with a not_stated finding saying Warranty is not stated produces no failure; an arbitrary inference with no evidence also produces no failure. This violates AC4 and the eval plan's source-grounding / not-stated accuracy requirements. Required bounded regressions: stated field plus contradictory not_stated => fail; genuinely absent field plus correct not_stated => pass; unsupported inference without canonical provenance => fail; grounded inference => pass. Because repeated source-grounding failures have exceeded the protocol's three-cycle threshold, QA escalated to PM and disabled forward work pending a bounded repair decision. No paid/live eval, YELLOW/RED action or scope expansion occurred.
